notes: τοῖς … κυρίοις is rule 92's recast with a separate antecedent pronoun (GAL.1.17's shape): the article owns 'them', and the noun keeps 'that are' together with the supplied 'your', the article being already spent (rule 76).
Both compounds headed on their root element — 'service' for -δουλία and 'pleasers' for -αρεσκος (rules 66, 91) — neither English word being a generic completion.
Vocative article unrepresented on a bare 'Servants' (rule 89); πάντα is anarthrous and heads on 'all' (rule 17).
